title: Quiet as a River
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
"I am the Lord who teaches you,"
He told His people so;
"I lead you in the way to walk,
The way that you should go."

[Chorus]
Shh, listen like a river, child,
He knows the way to go;
And when you listen for His voice,
Your peace will gently flow.

[Verse 2]
He led them through the desert sand,
No water there to see;
He split the rock, and out it gushed,
As cool as cool could be.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Wren stood so still beside the road
And pondered, soft and slow;
She asked once more, then walked the way
Her grandpa said to go.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my little one,
Your heart can be a stream;
He knows just where the water hides,
He'll keep you while you dream.

[Chorus]
mood: River music. A slow, even flow under the voice, like water moving over smooth stones, never hurrying and never stopping. A small harp picking out the current, one low cello note held underneath like the rock the water comes from. It stills a little more with every verse, as if the child is listening harder each time it quiets, until the last chorus is barely above a breath.
